description:
Connect ChatGPT to your Cobot coworking or flex space and manage it in plain language — ask things like "Book the blue meeting room for Jane tomorrow from 10 to 12.", "Which offices will be free next month?" or "Show me all unpaid invoices this month”. 

Once connected, ChatGPT can do things like:

- List bookable resources (rooms, desks, etc.) and check availability
- List and give details about memberships, teams, and visitor contacts
- List and inspect your invoices
- Show which offices or other resources are allocated or free.
- Create or change bookings, optionally on behalf of a member
- View a member's check-in history
- and more

Access is scoped to the spaces you manage in Cobot, with permissions matching what's granted to you in each space.

defaultPrompt: How many invoices are outstanding this month?
Which meeting rooms are available tommorrow noon?
